slides.title: Start with what loses sales
slides.body: A slow product page, search that fails on a typo, a checkout that demands an account. Fix those first.

slides.title: Shopify can do more than you think
slides.body: Custom themes, Functions and checkout extensions cover most of what stores assume the platform can't do.

slides.title: Most stores need fewer apps
slides.body: A dozen apps, several doing the same job, all loading on every page. Cutting them makes the store faster.

slides.title: Headless when the platform is the limit
slides.body: The theme can't render the brand, or you run a separate store per market. Then it earns its complexity.

slides.title: When we'd talk you out of it
slides.body: A two-person team, a theme that is mostly fine, or a six-week deadline. A custom theme ships sooner.
